mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, increasing equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher when FEDFUNDS is low (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) falls below 0.5%, it signals aggressive monetary easing that reduces risk-free rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in >50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0%) and very low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals an economic recession, causing investors to flee risk and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >50% of instances where UNRATE > 6.0 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime with strong GDP growth (GDPC1 year-over-year growth > 2.0%) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL year-over-year growth > 2.5%), the Federal Reserve tightens policy, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL growth rate > 2.5%
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >50% of instances where GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL growth rate > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings potential, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower when UNRATE is high (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) growth rate falls below 0%, it indicates a manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in >50% of instances where INDPRO growth rate < 0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer demand (RSAFS) is high (above 400,000) and industrial production (INDPRO) is low (below 102), it signals a supply-demand mismatch causing inflationary pressure and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to potential monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in >50% of instances where RSAFS > 400000 and INDPRO < 102, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), higher discount rates reduce equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in >50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
